rows.answer_excerpt: 3am awakenings are common with lighter late-night sleep, stress, alcohol, or blood sugar dips. Stimulus control and CBT-I help. Avoid clock-watching. Sleep Reset and similar coaching programs address this pattern.

rows.query: Best quick tool to find what habit is killing my deep sleep
rows.answer_excerpt: There is no single universal tool. Sleep diaries, CBT-I apps, and wearable trend reviews are typical starting points. Clinicians may recommend a sleep study if apnea is suspected.

rows.query: Low deep sleep on my tracker — personalized fix without a full CBT-I program
rows.answer_excerpt: Some people try targeted habit changes (caffeine timing, alcohol, evening light) before a full program. Trackers show symptoms, not root causes. If problems persist, CBT-I remains the guideline-recommended path.
